summary: Contestants will take an objective test to demonstrate their understanding of the core principles and practices of professional meeting and event management. The event covers topics such as event planning, budgeting, communication, ethics, and evaluating event success. Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
submission_requirements: Reference materials are not allowed. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
what_to_bring: (Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified
competencies: Plan and manage all aspects of an event project by organizing tasks, timelines, and resources
Recruit, schedule, and train staff or volunteers to support event operations
Manage the event budget by tracking expenses, handling monetary transactions, and making cost-effective decisions
Demonstrate knowledge of event design principles by planning the theme, program, agenda, room layout, speakers, performers, and key activities
Coordinate food, beverage, and vendor services according to event needs and expectations
Plan attendee flow and manage the event site by selecting an appropriate venue, designing the layout, and ensuring efficient movement and operations
Develop and manage event communication materials, including marketing pieces, signage, and merchandise
Communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal business interactions
Demonstrate professionalism by acting responsibly, ethically, respectfully, and with transparency
Identify potential risks and develop basic contingency plans for unexpected challenges
Apply sustainable and socially responsible practices in meeting and event planning when appropriate
Evaluate event success using attendee feedback, budget outcomes, and key performance indicators
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
